items.title: Mondelez International (MDLZ) Enters The US Protein Bar Market
items.summary: Mondelez International (NasdaqGS: MDLZ) has launched its UK protein bar brand Grenade in the U.S., expanding further into sports nutrition. The move targets growing demand from U.S. consumers for high protein, on the go snacks within the broader health and wellness segment. Grenade's U.S. rollout uses Mondelez International's existing distribution network to broaden the company's product mix beyond traditional snacks.
